title: Txt = "" matches both the empty-string row and the BLANK row
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "r", COUNTROWS ( FILTER ( Empty, Empty[Txt] = "" ) ) )

source.quote: Returns TRUE if Product[Color] is either BLANK or an empty string, otherwise returns FALSE
source.supports: Column = "" is TRUE for a BLANK and for an empty string

derivation: Empty[Txt] holds '' (Id 1), BLANK (Id 2), x (Id 3). = treats BLANK as equal to the empty string, so rows 1 and 2 match: 2 rows.
